# E0406: a lacuna's type is not a lacuna type

A lacuna's type is one of the lacuna types thema defines; the help lists them.
This one names a type that does not exist.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a:  string
				b?: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.1->0.0": {
		v0_1: _
		v0_0: {
			a: v0_1.a
		}
		lacunas: [
			{type: "Bogus", message: "b was dropped", condition: v0_1.b != _|_},
		]
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0406]: the lacuna's type is "Bogus", which is not a lacuna type
  --> lineage.cue:24:11
   |
24 |             {type: "Bogus", message: "b was dropped", condition: v0_1.b != _|_},
   |                    ^^^^^^^
   |
   = detail: lenses.0.1->0.0.lacunas.0.type: 7 errors in empty disjunction:
   = help: the lacuna types are "AmbiguousMapping", "ChangedDefault", "Defaulted", "DroppedField", "LossyFieldMapping", "Placeholder", "PrecisionLoss"
```
